_comment: Review panel registry (specs/review_panel.md). Domains: class ci = mechanical floor only; llm = agent verdict only; hybrid = mechanical floor + agent remainder. 'required' binds the merge gate on the LLM signal only - a declared gate_check is ALWAYS required at the merge gate regardless of 'required' (advisory LLM must never disable a mechanical floor). Signals are named <signal_prefix><domain> per head sha and must be created by the panel identity (project.json review.reviewer_logins). 'auto_pass_when_no_axes': the domain may publish success without an LLM spawn when its floor reports no applicable input.

security.floor: secret scan on the diff, forbidden APIs, dependency allowlist, project SAST command

quality.floor: project lint command, complexity metrics (cyclomatic/cognitive/CRAP when a tool is present), duplication

tester.floor: test compilation + pass/fail execution on the candidate

fidelity.floor: delegated design axes detection + impl-spec presence for declared axes

docs.floor: version/manifest sync, markdown link + anchor integrity, mandatory sections
